title: Selected procedure resource v1
description: One passive agentic-procedure JSON fence in Markdown. Paths resolve relative to the procedure file inside the repository; native resolution also checks confinement, byte limits, unique branch IDs and required resources. This contract grants no execution or authority.

id.description: Question identity local to this selected source.

question.description: Natural-language decision for the acting agent. Native resolution also bounds UTF-8 bytes.

branches.description: Named alternatives; branch IDs must be unique, and selection is supplied by the acting agent.

id.description: Identity used by a semantic branch answer.

description.description: Observable situation in which this alternative helps; native resolution also bounds UTF-8 bytes.

next.description: Confined path relative to this procedure file. Native selected resolution diagnoses missing resources.

context.description: Required source files relative to this procedure file, read and revision-bound with the question.

activation.description: Optional activation v1 declaration; omit when direct selection suffices. Native validation also checks UTF-8 byte limits and forbidden settlement selectors.

occasions.description: Current observations, missing prerequisites or owner restrictions which may nominate this method.

applicability.description: Natural-language situation the acting agent judges relevant.

outcome.description: Observable result that ends this procedure.

binding_owners.description: Existing component identities whose current restrictions may nominate the method; grants no component authority.

settled_by.description: Exact current result facts which may make this method unnecessary. Material, activation, route and procedure prefixes cannot settle their own relevance.

selector.description: JSON pointer into a current component result; native validation rejects self-settling prefixes.
